race.comment: MAGNABELLE ROYALE (6) was an impressive track-an-trip winner here fresh back in September when exploding down the centre of the track. Went amiss second-up and then was held up here in the straight third-up, before letting down strongly late. Gets in well with the 3kg claimer taking over. Watch for her bursting through. MAINMANKASH (1) has been freshened with 62 days after being given absolutely no peace at Sandown-Hillside, but was still okay late. Maskiell takes back over with a strong association. Expect him to go hammer and tong again in front. SPEIR (2) beat MAGNABELLE ROYALE home last time now meets her 4.5kgs worse after Kinninmont's claim. Will charge to the front and give another bold sight. WEAPON CLEAR (5) returns and is a two time winner fresh, including last prep at Bendigo when leading pillar-to-post. Expect him to inject plenty of speed into this contest.
